baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction `إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ` directs the active state `نَاظِرَةٌ` toward `رَبِّهَا`.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sight-or-insight branch of `ن ظ ر` combines with the ownership and authority branch of `ر ب ب`, yielding deliberate apprehension of the faces' sovereign rather than an unspecified look.

activation_trace.role: Lordship, ownership, and authority identify the object of directed apprehension as the faces' sovereign.
Directing sight or insight to apprehend a thing supplies the verse's basic intentional gaze.

changed_reading.before: The faces merely look in an unspecified way.
changed_reading.after: The faces deliberately direct sight or insight toward their sovereign Lord.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: `نَاظِرَةٌ` is predicated of the faces with a directional complement toward their `رَبّ`.
baseline_models.mechanism: The waiting-and-respite branch of `ن ظ ر` and the nurture-and-completion branch of `ر ب ب` permit a temporal relation: the faces await from their Lord the completion of their condition.

activation_trace.role: Watching for the time and awaiting respite supplies an expectant rather than purely optical state.
Repair, nurture, and completion make the Lord the awaited agent who brings the faces' state to fulfillment.

changed_reading.before: The faces are occupied with looking.
changed_reading.after: The faces wait upon their Lord for a condition he will complete.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The active participle `نَاظِرَةٌ` presents a continuing state oriented `إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا`.
baseline_models.mechanism: The staying, clinging, and drawing-near branch of `ر ب ب` lengthens the directed apprehension of `ن ظ ر` into settled orientation rather than a passing glance.

activation_trace.role: Staying, clinging, lasting, and drawing near supply duration and proximity to the Lordward orientation.
Directed sight or insight supplies the attention that becomes settled rather than momentary.

changed_reading.before: The verse records a momentary glance toward the Lord.
changed_reading.after: The verse presents an abiding Lordward orientation of sight and awareness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Oath-backed resurrection, the self exposed as its own inward witness, and the delivered report of deeds place the sovereign-directed gaze inside an accountable audience. Looking is not detached observation; the person is apprehending the authority before whom the self is already legible.

activation_trace.role: Lordship, ownership, and authority supply the sovereign side of the audience.
Directed sight or insight anchors the audience in the focus predicate.
An oath apportioned to its parties supplies solemn attestation for the coming audience.
Resurrection and the rising of the Hour establish the occasion on which the gaze occurs.
The thing's own self or identity makes the accountable person, not an external record alone, evidentially present.
Insight of the heart makes the focus gaze continuous with inward moral perception.
A delivered report supplies the disclosure of what the person sent ahead and left behind.

structural_cues: 75:1-15 moves from sworn resurrection to report, self-witness, and failed excuses before the face scene.
The focus keeps the possessive relation `their Lord`, preserving personal accountability inside the collective plural faces.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies resurrection, sovereign lordship, reported deeds, and inward self-witness; I infer that their convergence turns the focus gaze into an accountable audience. A live alternative is non-forensic delighted attention after judgment has already ended.

changed_reading.before: The faces direct attention toward a sovereign object.
changed_reading.after: The faces knowingly meet the sovereign before whom their deeds and inner selves are disclosed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence denies escape and refuge, names the Lord as the settlement, repeats the focus's `إِلَىٰ رَبّ` construction, and later names the Lordward driving. The gaze becomes one station in an unavoidable terminal orientation toward the same Lord.

activation_trace.role: Staying, lasting, and drawing near anchor the focus Lord as the endpoint of abiding proximity.
Directed apprehension supplies the focus's conscious orientation within the larger movement.
Flight and escape supply the attempted movement that the next verse closes off.
A refuge supplies the absent alternative destination.
Lordship and ownership identify the sovereign endpoint in the first repeated `toward your Lord` construction.
Fixity and settlement make that Lordward endpoint terminal rather than provisional.
Staying and drawing near reinforce the same endpoint in the second repeated `toward your Lord` construction.
Driving and herding supply compelled motion toward that endpoint.

structural_cues: The exact directional frame recurs at 75:12, 75:23, and 75:30: toward the Lord as settlement, gaze, and driving.
The focus lies between the denial of refuge and the deathbed movement toward the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies no escape, Lordward settlement, the repeated directional construction, and Lordward driving; I infer that the focus gaze participates in terminal arrival. Alternatively, the gaze may describe the rewarded state only after the movement has ended.

changed_reading.before: The faces voluntarily look toward their Lord in an isolated scene.
changed_reading.after: Their gaze is the conscious, settled phase of the surah's inescapable movement toward the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command not to hasten, but to follow a received recitation and await its disclosure, is followed by the contrast between the immediate and the later. It activates `ن ظ ر` as patient expectancy and `ر ب ب` as staged completion.

activation_trace.role: Watching for the proper time and granting respite supplies the focus's patient expectancy.
Nurture and completion supply a Lord who unfolds and completes what is awaited.
Laterness after what comes first supplies the deferred horizon that haste neglects.
Hurrying and bringing forward supply the prohibited attempt to seize completion prematurely.
Following behind supplies receptive sequencing in place of anticipatory control.
Disclosure of meaning by speech or sign supplies the completion that arrives from beyond the receiver.

structural_cues: 75:16-21 opposes hurried self-movement to receiving, following, disclosure, and the deferred hereafter immediately before the face scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prohibited haste, instructed following, promised disclosure, and the immediate/later contrast; I infer the same receptive timing sharpens the focus's waiting branch. The alternative is that the recitation unit concerns only delivery technique and does not color the later gaze.

changed_reading.before: The faces wait generally for something from their Lord.
changed_reading.after: The faces embody unhurried receptivity, awaiting the Lord's own timing and completion rather than forcing the outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah supplies both the facial surface and its radiance; the focus then supplies that face's Lordward apprehension. Read as a two-predicate sequence, orientation is registered outwardly as transformed appearance.

activation_trace.role: Directed sight or insight supplies the Lordward relation that the face visibly carries.
Nurture, repair, and completion make the Lord a plausible relational source of the completed facial state.
The face as the forward-facing surface supplies the body part on which the changed state appears.
Fresh beauty and radiance supply the visible transformation paired with the focus gaze.

structural_cues: The indefinite plural `faces` at 75:22 carries consecutive active-participial predicates across the ayah boundary.
The near-paronomasia `ناضرة / ناظرة` binds facial radiance to directed attention while keeping their roots distinct.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one face with adjacent radiance and gaze predicates; I infer a relational arrow from Lordward orientation to visible radiance. The live alternative is simple coexistence: the face is radiant and also looks, without one state causing the other.

changed_reading.before: Radiant faces happen also to look toward their Lord.
changed_reading.after: The Lordward encounter is visibly registered on the faces as fresh radiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opposing faces grimace while anticipating with sign-based certainty that a back-breaking event will be done to them. That parallel keeps the focus's waiting branch live: the bright faces can be awaiting the opposite action from their completing Lord.

activation_trace.role: Watching for the time supplies positive expectancy on the bright side of the contrast.
Repair and completion supply the agent from whom the positive faces await an opposite outcome.
Facial grimacing and intense aversion supply the negative affective pole.
Certainty reached from an indication supplies anticipatory knowledge rather than a completed event.
The bringing about of an act supplies what the opposing faces expect to be done to them.
A back-breaking calamity supplies the feared negative outcome against which positive expectancy is inferred.

structural_cues: 75:22-23 and 75:24-25 form matched face pairs: visible facial state followed by orientation toward an anticipated outcome.
The positive pair names the Lord; the negative pair names what the faces expect will be done to them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies syntactic parallelism, negative anticipation, and a feared act; I infer an opposite positive anticipation from the Lord on the first side. The alternative is that `ناظرة` remains direct seeing while only `تظن` carries anticipation.

changed_reading.before: The faces wait upon their Lord without a specified polarity.
changed_reading.after: The bright faces expect beneficent completion from their Lord, in polar contrast to faces certain of a back-breaking act.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exact bodily re-forming at the opening and staged formation plus reanimation at the close fill `رَبِّهَا` with the work of nurture and completion. The restored face looks toward the one who measured, formed, completed, and revived it.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, administration, and completion supply the dominant relational model for the Lord.
The non-dominant mapped image of nurture and growing up adds stage-by-stage development without replacing the dominant Lordship root.
Directed apprehension makes the completed creature consciously recognize its source.
Effective capacity reaching action and dominion supplies the power to re-form the body.
Intrinsic straightness and completion supply exact restoration down to the fingertips.
Clear fluid from drop to abundance, including reproductive fluid, supplies the first small material stage.
A pregnancy fixed in the womb supplies the attached developmental stage.
Completed creation and balanced form supply the formed body that can bear the radiant face.
Living spirit and animate life supply the restored vitality of the once-dead subject.
Loss of power and life supplies the condition reversed by reanimation.

structural_cues: The surah brackets the face scene with reassembly at 75:3-4 and embryonic formation plus resurrection at 75:37-40.
The possessive `their Lord` can therefore recall a continuous relation from first formation through re-formation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact re-forming, staged creation, life, death, and both dominant and non-dominant nurture branches for the focus root; I infer that `their Lord` gathers those acts into recognition of a completer. Sovereign ownership remains a live alternative emphasis, and the non-dominant `ر ب و` image is supplementary only.

changed_reading.before: The faces look toward a generically sovereign Lord.
changed_reading.after: Newly restored faces recognize the Lord who nurtured their form stage by stage and completed it again after death.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's `toward their Lord` is answered by the rejecter's `went toward his family` after turning away, with swagger marking self-satisfied social return. The focus gaze can therefore function as ethical reorientation and allegiance, not optics alone.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and obeyed mastery supply the rightful center of allegiance.
Directed sight or insight supplies the enacted turn toward that center.
Turning the back and withdrawing supply the rejected orientation.
Going and passing away supply movement toward the rival social destination.
The group of kinship and belonging supplies the familiar center named after the parallel `toward` construction.
Swagger through extended posture supplies the self-satisfied manner of the rival orientation.

structural_cues: `إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا` at 75:23 and `إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ` at 75:33 repeat the same directional frame with different possessed centers.
The later movement follows denial and turning away, making direction ethically charged.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel `toward + possessed noun` constructions, turning away, movement to kin, and swagger; I infer a contrast of ultimate allegiance. The alternative is a narrative contrast of destinations without assigning ethical orientation to the lexical sense of `ناظرة`.

changed_reading.before: The faces perform a visual act toward their Lord.
changed_reading.after: Their gaze enacts allegiance to the Lord rather than the rejecter's retreat into familiar kinship and self-display.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the form-distant `human image in the pupil` branch from repeated `human` language, not the ordinary contextual sense of `الإنسان`. It remains anchored because the focus inventory itself names `ناظرة` as the eye or pupil and the surah joins bodily sight to inward insight. Downstream prose should present it only as an optical-moral image, never as a lexical translation of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus `نَاظِرَةٌ` has an explicit branch naming the eye and the place of sight within it.

activation_trace.role: The eye and its pupil supply the literal optical location in which the exploratory image is staged.
Lordship and ownership preserve the focus's actual relational object while the optical image unfolds.
The human image reflected in the pupil supplies a miniature self within the organ of looking.
Insight of the heart turns the optical miniature into self-disclosure rather than visual anatomy alone.

changed_reading.before: A person uses the eye to look outward toward the Lord.
changed_reading.after: The Lordward pupil becomes an exploratory site where the human self is imaged and inwardly disclosed while looking.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the surface syntax explicitly states the faces' looking, not a reciprocal divine gaze. It remains valid as a relational activation because the focus branch describes facing in which things see one another and the adjacent face branch supplies confrontation. Downstream prose should say `mutual facing` or `exposure to being seen`, not assert a doctrinally complete account of reciprocal vision.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: `نَاظِرَةٌ` is directed toward the Lord and its focus inventory includes facing so that things see one another.

activation_trace.role: Facing in which things see one another changes one-way observation into relational exposure.
Sovereign lordship keeps that reciprocal exposure asymmetrical in authority.
Confrontation and face-to-face meeting supply the embodied geometry of mutual presence.

changed_reading.before: The faces observe the Lord from one side of a visual relation.
changed_reading.after: The faces enter sovereign mutual presence: looking while exposed to being seen.

strongest_changes: The repeated `toward the Lord` frame turns the gaze into the settled conscious phase of an inescapable Lordward destination.
The immediate bright-versus-grim face parallel sustains both a visibly transformative encounter and a positive expectant reading.
Opening reassembly and closing formation and reanimation fill `their Lord` with stage-by-stage nurture and restorative completion.
The later parallel movement `toward his family` makes Lordward looking an ethical orientation and allegiance.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed three recurrences of the same Lordward directional construction, a compact facial polarity, and a creation-to-recreation bracket. It also allowed the non-dominant `ر ب و` nurture branch to sharpen, without replacing, the dominant `ر ب ب` relation.
remaining_uncertainties: Direct apprehension and expectant waiting remain coexisting readings of `نَاظِرَةٌ`; the packet strengthens both but does not force disambiguation.
The adjacency of radiance and gaze does not itself prove that the gaze causes the radiance.
The non-dominant `ر ب و` mapping is useful corroboration but should not carry the restorative model by itself.
The pupil-reflection and reciprocal-exposure outliers are branch-grounded images, not replacements for the surface construction.
